summary_bullets.claim: Ease of use and offline access are dominant strengths — emphasize these in marketing copy.

evidence.quote: This took a while to download - but it is the entire Bible and can be read offline. And it's free!

summary_bullets.claim: Highlighting and note-taking features are popular — promote these in marketing copy.

evidence.quote: I've had many different Bible apps and each one in their own way was hard to use. This KJV one is VERY useful. my favorite features are the highlighting and notes.

summary_bullets.claim: Audio feature is a bonus — mention it in marketing copy.

evidence.quote: I love it because the bible is available off line. I have searched for such an app for a while and I am grateful I found this one. It also as an audio feature. Awesome

summary_bullets.claim: King James Version preference among users — cater to this in marketing copy.

evidence.quote: King James version is my favorite version of the Bible. I love to read God's Word daily and this app helps me to do just that.

summary_bullets.claim: App is useful for church services — emphasize this in marketing copy.

evidence.quote: I use this app as my Bible in church every time we have a service. It helps me find where I'm going really fast and I can keep notes and write things to myself on it.
